How to recycle my Mattress and Box Spring
Town Residents can contact UTEC to recycle a MATTRESS and BOX SPRING, choose
“Schedule Service” for curbside pickup - $40 per item. Dropped off at warehouse on Tuesdays
and Thursdays from 7:30 am to 2:00 pm, - $30 per item.
https://utecinc.org/mattress-recycling/
Location:
UTEC
231 B Neck Road
Haverhill, MA 01835
978.856.3902
Who is UTEC?
UTEC is a nonprofit organization that helps at-risk young adults, between the ages of 17-25. This
special team teaches life skills, instills healthy routines and builds strong working relationships. At
the Haverhill warehouse, they are taught how to manually deconstruct and extract recyclable
material from the mattresses and box springs. 85% of the mattress is recycled. The young adults
participate in the deconstruction as well as unloading deliveries of mattresses, and developing
valuable warehouse skills. From the mattress and box springs, foam becomes carpet underlay.
Wood becomes mulch, and metal springs become hardware, (nails, screws, and bolts). The young
adults are compensated for their hard work.
UTEC is contracted with municipalities, schools, universities, assisted living facilities, and
privately-owned apartment and condo complexes.
